purpose: Physically reduce the repeated 50,257-token output projection using only search/train material while retaining complete byte-level realizability. This is a deployment-graph optimization of the exact v24 weights, not new language training.

allowed_to_select_output_token_ids: the 256 GPT-2 byte-alphabet base token IDs
token IDs occurring in search-only ABI English prompts or responses
token IDs occurring in the locked general-English train split
deterministic ascending tokenizer IDs used only to fill preregistered cardinality budgets
information_boundary.complete_realizability: All 256 GPT-2 byte-alphabet base tokens remain available, so excluded merge tokens affect efficiency and model preference but cannot make a UTF-8 byte sequence intrinsically unrepresentable.

nested_budgets.construction: previous plus every token in allowed ABI/general train responses
previous plus every token in allowed ABI/general train prompts
previous plus ascending tokenizer IDs until cardinality 4096
previous plus ascending tokenizer IDs until cardinality 8192
previous plus ascending tokenizer IDs until cardinality 16384
previous plus ascending tokenizer IDs until cardinality 32768

search_and_promotion_rule.early_stop: Stop expanding after the first budget passes every locked gate and its immediately lower tested budget has failed at least one gate.
required_quality: all 1,400 locked ABI validation rows pass with zero source-passing regression and perfect routing
at least 95 percent parent top-1 agreement over all 420 general-validation rows and exactly 43,089 response tokens
required_native_performance: median generated UTF-8 bytes per complete request second at least 2x locked optimized Qwen
paired-prompt bootstrap 95 percent lower bound at least 2x
at least 95 percent of the selected contemporaneous parent runtime or the locked sealed Phase 2 parent, with the comparator lineage stated explicitly
search_and_promotion_rule.minimum_claim: Only the lowest passing preregistered tested nested budget paired with the largest lower failing budget. Never an absolute or global minimum.
